capacitance_references.description: Nominal low-frequency mutual capacitance, bias and temperature independent. No corner or mismatch variation. Engineering density estimate, not silicon-validated.
capacitance_references.valid_when: w>0 && l>0 && m>0 && mmin>=1 && mmax>=mmin && mmax<=4 && floor(mmin)==mmin && floor(mmax)==mmax

capacitance_references.description: Nominal low-frequency mutual capacitance, excluding substrate shunts and series R/L. No corner or mismatch variation. Densities for more than two layers are derived from the sibling stack.
capacitance_references.valid_when: w>0 && l>0 && m>0 && mmin>=1 && mmax>=mmin && mmax<=4 && floor(mmin)==mmin && floor(mmax)==mmax && mmax>mmin && (feed==0 || feed==1 || feed==2)
